dedupe_keys.name: soilsense soil moisture sensor api and webhooks

description: SoilSense sells soil moisture sensors with a documented REST API and real-time webhooks that give customers programmatic access to their readings. The API returns farms, observation sites and full measurement history as JSON, including volumetric water content, temperature, salinity and plant-available water at every depth plus rainfall from connected rain gauges, and a latest-reading call for live dashboards. Telemetry webhooks push new readings to the user's endpoint as they arrive, attribute webhooks report site changes, and requests can be verified with HMAC-SHA256 signatures. It is produced by SoilSense, a company with a Danish telephone contact. Coverage is wherever customers install sensors, so it is global in principle. Access requires buying the SoilSense system and authenticating with a personal API key; the page read gives no prices, so cost is on purchase. Caveats: the data belong to each customer and are not a public dataset, and the page is product material. For simulation it is a source of live soil moisture streams for irrigation control, farm digital twins and drought monitoring models that need real-time field data. It is related to the WHIN open soil sensor dataset record in this catalogue, a public research sample of similar measurements.
